body: 18 engine retarget/ options found in 4.7.2-stable across 3 post-import plugins; engine does silhouette fixing (bone direction alignment to profile), position-track normalisation via motion_scale, node-transform baking, and bone renaming that ours does not; ours is a partial re-implementation of Overwrite Axis (bone map, rest correction, per-frame rotation retarget cover the same math) but missing fix_silhouette which is the most plausible cause of 'looks bad' on proportion-different rigs; gate Q82_check.py exits 0; pushed to qwen/q82-engine-retarget
